You signal the rush and watch two companions strike together, each arriving where the other needs them.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Two willing allies within 4 squares that can perceive your signal.
Duration
Immediate movement and attacks.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; normal action economy applies.
Type
Signature

Each ally may move up to 3 squares without provoking, then make one free Basic Melee attack against an adjacent enemy if able. Resolve one ally completely before the other. On a Strong result, the attack may push its target 1.
